text:
emma_support: Support -> CS: CatalystBio trial blocked on onboarding. Large portion of their docs never finished indexing after a scheduled credential rotation; ingest returns 401/403 intermittently and embeddings missing for ~40% of records. Activation dropped from 58% -> 31%. Sales check-in in 5 days. Need CS bridge + a clear customer-facing note.

raj_se: Confirmed on their tenant. Automated credential rotation flipped a storage access role; some workers retried and got 403 while others continued. Result: partial index, embeddings absent for many docs (hence low similarity). I applied a tenant-scoped fallback to old creds and queued an emergency reindex job. Internal ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/13299

zoe_csm: I'll lead the customer bridge and own communication. Can someone give a one-paragraph, non-tech blurb I can send before the call? Scheduling 30m at 1pm PT. @phil_csm_mgr FYI  if we can't get indexing back to >85% in 24h we should trigger renewal mitigation.

phil_csm_mgr: Understood. Prep mitigation: (1) 1-week trial extension, (2) account credit if >24h impact, (3) dedicated enablement + index audit. Zoe, capture sentiment and confirm whether they want a data export or reingest window.

raj_se: Customer-facing snippet: "We experienced a credentials rotation that temporarily impacted document indexing for your account. We've applied a tenant-specific fallback, started an emergency reindex, and expect most documents to be available within ~45 minutes. We'll review progress on the bridge and share a remediation timeline."

emma_support: Pushed minimal logs and the error sample for the call: `storage_client::403 "access_denied" at 2026-08-12T12:11:02Z` and `index_progress: 62% -> 55% partial after rotation`.

incidents_bot: Incident 13299 created and escalated to CS. Priority: P2. Bridge scheduled: 2026-08-12T13:00:00-07:00. Eng oncall paged.

zoe_csm: Thanks. Comms owners: immediate ping = Zoe, bridge tech RCA = Raj + Emma, post-call remediation & credits = Phil. I'll send an apology note and invite now.

raj_se: Runbook rotate/rollback snippet: ```bash
# fallback to previous service account for tenant
curl -X POST https://internal/api/admin/tenant/rotate-creds \
  -d '{"tenant":"catalystbio","action":"fallback","creds":"service-account-old"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

emma_support: Invite sent to Catalyst contact, Zoe, Phil, Raj. I'll join early to stream logs and confirm reindex progress. Sync 10m before.

zoe_csm: Great. After the call I'll update the renewal risk flag, attach a short pulse survey for onboarding friction, and propose credits if indexing <85% after 24h. :handshake:
